environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with an internet-facing ALB (Application Load Balancer). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ALB forwards to target group on port 8080. No WAF attached. Audit logs are shipped to CloudWatch Logs and consumed by a SIEM that triggers alerts based on log pattern matching (e.g., AUTH_SUCCESS from unexpected IPs). An attacker on the internet can forge log entries to create false SIEM alerts or hide malicious activity.

config.log_pipeline: CloudWatch Logs -> SIEM with pattern-based alerting
